title: A product launch in four weeks

steps.label: Plan and scope
steps.detail: Agree the goals and the date
steps.narration: The first week is for planning, agreeing the goals, and fixing the launch date.

steps.label: Build the core
steps.detail: Ship the main flow end to end
steps.narration: In week two the team builds the core flow and gets it working from start to end.

steps.label: Test with users
steps.narration: Week three puts the product in front of testers, and the team fixes what they find.

steps.label: Launch
steps.narration: Finally the launch goes out, and the team watches the first numbers come in.
